title: DRIP quest
description: A custom quest. The file's name becomes the quest's ID, so name it something unique and descriptive - for example A_WILD_NIGHT.jsonc. Everything mechanical (condition IDs, locale keys, quest structure) is generated from these decisions when the server loads.

$schema.description: Points your editor at this schema so you get autocomplete. Leave it alone.

name.description: The quest's name as players see it in their journal.

trader.description: Which trader offers this quest. Use a DRIP trader (moron, georgia), a vanilla trader name (ragman, fence, prapor, therapist, skier, peacekeeper, mechanic, jaeger, lighthousekeeper, btr, ref), or a raw 24-character trader ID.

description.description: What the trader says when they offer the quest. Shown in the journal. Optional, but players will read it.

onSuccess.description: What the trader says when the quest is completed. Optional.

onFail.description: What the trader says when the quest is failed. Optional and rarely used.

image.description: The quest's picture in the journal. Either one of this pack's .png files sitting beside the quest configs (for example "Boozey.png"), or a vanilla quest icon's 24-character ID to reuse the game's own art.

requires.description: What must be true before the player can start this quest. Delete the whole 'requires' block if anyone can start it.

playerLevel.description: The player level needed before this quest appears.

quest.description: A quest that must be completed first. Write the other quest's FILENAME (for example "A_WILD_NIGHT") or its 24-character ID.

objectives.description: What the player must do to complete the quest. Each objective is either a 'handover' (give items to the trader) or a 'kill' (eliminate targets). Every objective needs its own 'text' - the sentence players read.

handover.description: The item to hand over. Write a DRIP item's FILENAME (they look like MUSTACHE_DARKGREY_FACE) or a 24-character item ID.

foundInRaid.description: Whether the items must be found in raid. True is the normal case.

text.description: The sentence players read in the journal, for example "Find in-raid and hand over two bottles of Vodka."

kill.description: Who to eliminate. "Any" for anyone, or a bot type ID.

at.description: Optional. Restrict it to one location, for example "factory".

with.description: Optional. Restrict it to one weapon, by 24-character item ID.

text.description: The sentence players read in the journal, for example "Eliminate 5 Scavs on Factory."

rewards.description: What the player receives on completion. Mix as many as you like: experience, standing, unlock, item.

experience.description: XP granted on completion, for example 4000.

standing.description: How much standing to grant. 0.03 is a typical amount.

standingWith.description: Which trader the standing is with. Leave it out to use the quest's own trader.

unlock.description: A trader whose full stock becomes available once this quest is done.

item.description: The item granted. Write a DRIP item's FILENAME or a 24-character item ID. Roubles are an item too - 5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f.

itemCount.description: How many of the item. For money, this is the amount.
